title: Letter: Starboard has taken a significant stake in observability company Dynatrace and is pushing for changes to boost the stock; DT jumps 7%+ after hours (Lauren Thomas/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Lauren Thomas / Wall Street Journal: Letter: Starboard has taken a significant stake in observability company Dynatrace and is pushing for changes to boost the stock; DT jumps 7%+ after hours — Dynatrace shares have underperformed its peers and Starboard is pushing for changes to turn things around
